note: Fails if a bare unique name stops resolving to its entity's fqid, a bare name two variables share stops being a 409 listing both (pid order), an unknown id stops being a 404, or an id outside the public-id grammar (four segments) stops being a 422, or an unknown parameter is ignored instead of refused, or a retired id (`demo/reg2/gone`, retired.toml) stops being a 404 `retired_ref` naming its kind, the catalog version that retired it and the reason instead of `not_found`. The shared resolver raises it for every operation, so this one step is the cases' only retired_ref (test_mcp.py PINNED_ONCE).
